Btsiaw mano re kapok i kkuin ska Jem kat kan ong: *Ha i kam tkok jingtkok, ym kit kan lek laplieng kumka ym lak kek lew skuk; la kumka ka por ka la tkmit ek, lok Jiik ei ka pansngiat M.Pkil ne Pk.D’. Pleng skiska kam long kumta! KynJiang nga skakskkor kaJ kurom la i jingpasiaw. Kam pker Ju, laUoi ne elem, stet ne suki. Dei tang ka ka sklem jong ka por keifi ka i fiianglong ka ijli in kylla tkapkaliek ka kawei ka engi. Kumta, nga la aste ka lek kyikiek kek por; kknang ka kata Sa kaka la p)rnkang kan trud kad pntid dak, kalai pa kalai, kan kkam wandur kad janai. ^Kkt kamar pyiakak kane ka tkcmg, ym lak lait, ki jingduna kin don oeit. Nga la ong akiaien ka kawei ka jingialang pyllait kot ka Laitumkkrak da kine ki kyntien: Xada u nongtkok u kam kynti la lade ka u la janai, ka ka jingtkok ruk ka la janai, uta u la dei kan skongtkait nok syndon na ka kam tkok kot\ Hapok ki sla jong kane ka kitak, pki ki lok nongpule pkin skem Ya ka kynta kaka ar de. Lyngka kane, pkin Yoki kad sngewtkuk Ya ka dur jong ka Saitsokpen. Nga nud kan ong skkeni ka ki laipkew snem eiei, kata 1835-1865, jong ka jingsynsliar ka sorkar Kompeni, ka Ri Kkasi, ka la man long ka juk 'ki kam palat ain suda'. Ki Nongsynskar ki kat kad tkew pylla da ka tarajur ka jingkymkok. Wat u Jolin Brigkt (181M889), u M.R kad u riewsaidtkma ka pawnam jong ka ri Bilad, ka ka jingkren paidkak jong u ka Birmingkam, ka u Nokprak 18 tarik 1862, u la kyntkok jur Ya ka dur synskar kkadar da ka sorkar Kompeni ka ri India ki. Kumne u la ong: ... ka ka kistory jong ka Ri Bilad Bakkraw ka India ka skuwa ka 1862 ka la man long 'ki skispak snem jong ka kam keain suda pyrskak la ki trai ri kajem jong ka

kima India*. Ki kyntien jong u ka ka pkareng ki long da kumne: ... tkat tke kistory of Great Britain in India prior to 1862 was *a kundred years of crime against tke docile natives of our Indian empire*. (RE. Rokerts: History of British India, Pt. II, ckap. I, p. 388). Skiska, katno tarn ka la long ka ka pyrtkei Saitsokpen! Ki sngi jong u Tkdmas Jones ka Sokra ki long 'ka juk ki kam palat ain suda* (an age of crimes), kumka ong u Rokerts. Halor ka jingim u Tkomas Jones, ki kam ki jingtrei, u synniang u kynkei jong u ska ka ri kad ka jaidkynriew, dang dei ek kan lai kkyllie stong da ki riewi^tad kad riewprok jakieiig ka juk mynta. Nga la ieknok Lyll ai ki liewpongskai kum ka jingtyngkai lem i'a ki symkok jingtip na ka kynta kita ki stad ki jkad. Ka jingim jong u ka dap da ki jingkukriek ka kun syrtap. Hapd eng ka jingpyrkkat kkim jingmut, kum ki nongialam, kunsien ek la ju dok pynnok skiliang i'a ki ar pylla jong ka tarajur. Kam long kaka dei. Donkam ka jingtkir jingtkain nia kad ka jingkiskar kniak kalor kane ka pkang. Uta *ia uka ngi ‘latei mot mynta u la dik i'a ki umktkang mluk kalor ki jingat pkyllung. Ong u Dostoyevsky skisien: ‘Ki riewkkraw skiska, nga puson te, ki dei kan mad ka sngewsik-kkuslai kakkraw ka pyrtkei\ Kumjuk kein, ka la long 'la ka jingim ka lyngkot jong u Tkomas Jones. Hynrei pynkan, na kine karok, la kyrsei ki sok katkiang jong ka kistory. S.S, Majaw, — Ka Bynta I Ka Khronoloji U Thoma* Jon(j» 1810; January 24 tarik. La kha ia u T. Jones ha Tanyffridd, Llangyniew, Montgomery. U khim ba ar napdeng shiphew ngut shipara. Ki kmie ki kpa jong u dei u Edward bad ka Mary Jones. U kpa u del tang u misteri. February 25 ttuik. La pynbaptis ia u T. Jones ha ka Balang ha Tanyffridd, kaba hap hapoh ka Parish Llangyniew. 1813 : Mynba u T. Jones u dang dap kumba lai snem, ka longiing

ka la kynriah jaka noh bad leit shong ha Liverpool, na ka daw ki kam ki jingtrei, ka kamai kajih u kpa jong u. U la ioh ban trei ia ka kam shna shalyntem kali. Ka dei ka por jong ka jingkhie rasong ki kam karkhana, kam barikor. (First Phase of industrial revolution). 1819 : Sa shiwat, ka iing ka sem u T. Jones ka la kynriah shnong biang na Liverpool sha Berriew, na ki daw ka jingbymshait bym koit u kpa. Naduh kane ka por la tip i^ u T. Jones kum u nong Berriew. 2 U Thocnas Jones Bad Ka Pyrthei Saitsohpen 1835 : U la sdang ban iialap ia ka Gospel. Da ka bor u Mynsiem bakhuid, u la lalap ha kawei na ki jingiaseng jong ka Welsh Association kaba la long ha Bethel, Llanidloes, ka jingiathuhkhana kaba nyngkong jong u. Dei ha kane ka snem ruh ba u la lohsngew ia ka jingkhot jong U Blei ban leit Yalap la ka Gospel sha ri India. 1837 : La plie ia ka skul bah ha Bala, ka jaka hikai ban pyntbit na ka bynta ki nongiathuh khana bad nongialap. Kam dei ka skul Thioloji. U Thomas Jones u la ioh rung ha kane ka skul ban pule ia ka course kaba ar snem. U dei uwei na ki khadar ngut ki samla pule kiba nyngkong eh. Ka Aiom khie rasong ha ki kam karkhana ka la kynjoh lapeh sha u mawjan uba ar (second phase). 1839 ; U la pyndep ia ka jingpule na ka kolej ha Bala. Ha kajuh ka por, u la leit thep ia ka aplikeshon jong u sha ka ophis jong ka London Missionary Society, ban tyrwa ia lade kum u missionary sha ri India, kat kum ka jingkhot U Blei bad jingangnud jong u. Ha u September 9 tarik, ka Board ki Dairektor jong ka LMS ka la shong pyrkhat halor ka jingty rwa u Thomas Jones. Hadien ar bnai, imat ha ka taiew khatduh u November, la khot ia u sha ka interbiw ha khmat ka Board. La rai ban phah

ia u kum u missionary sha Caffaria, ha South Africa. 1840 ; Tarik 1 January. La thung pynkyntang phadri ia u Thomas Jones ha ka jingiaseng Presbytery ha Bala. Duna 23 sngi ba un dap pura 30 snem ka rta. Ha ka 27 tarik u January. La khot biang ia. u T. Jones ha khmat ki Dairektor ka LMS. Hangta hi, u la sei U Tlwmas Jones Bad Ka Pyrthei Saitsohpen 3 syndon lai tylli ki sertiphiket na ki lai ngut ki doktor ba pawkhmat bha. Tarik 31 u January, ha lingmane Rose Place ha Liverpool, da ka jingialang ba la khot kyrkieh eh, la mih ka jingi'akut ban seng bad pynlong noh la ka jong ka Foreign Missionary Society. Kane ka jia na ka daw ka jingshah kyntait beift u T. Jones ha ka LMS. Ha u bnai April. Da ka rai jong ka jingi'aseng bah ha Llanfair Caereinion, la seng bad pynlong noh la ka Foreign Missionary Society la kajong, da kaba iadkhat sohpet na ka London Missionary Society. U bnai October. Ha Dolgellau, da ka jingrhem mynsiem kaba khraw, ki parabangeit ki la Ya pynlong ka jingialum synhiang kylluid war na ka bynta ka jingleit missionary u T. Jones sha ri India. Ha u November 4 tarik. Ka sngi Balang, la pynlong ka jingiaseng ai khublei ha ling mane Rose Place, Liverpool. Ka jingiaseng ka la neh jin lai kynta shiteng ei ei. November 5 tarik. Ka jhad ka la dei ban mih na kad jhad Liverpool. La jia ka eriong ba jur. Kumta la pynkynriah tarik noh. November 25 tarik. Ka suiflbneng ka la bha pat. Da ka jhad Jamaica, u T. Jones bad ka lok jong u ki la mih na Liverpool ban wan sha ri Khasi (India). U Missionary uba nyngkong eh ba la phah da ka Foreign Missionary Society jong ka Balang ri Wales. 1841 : April 23 tarik. Ki la hiar lieng bad kiew ryngkew ha Kolkata. 4 U Thomas lones Bad Ka Pyrthel SaHsohpen Ha u June 22 tank. La poi bad luh kjat ha Sohra (Saitsohpen), ha pdeng ka lyiur

bad u lapbah ^hra. La pdiang sngewbha bad khot iing basa da u Kapten William Lewin. 1842 : U T. Jones u la plie skul: nyngkong ha Mawsmai, ba ar ha Mawmluh, ba lai ha Sohra. U la pynmih ia ki kot rit : Ka First Khasi Primer, nangta ka Rhoddmain (Mother's gift). Ha ki bnai pyrem, u leit ialap sha Ri War Tyrna, Mawlong, Nongkroh, Nongwar bad Tynrong. Ha ki bnai synrai, u leit ialap sha ki thain Ri War Jaifltia, u da jurip de ha kino ki shnong lah ban plie skul. U la pan jaka na u Syiem Suba Sing ka Hima Sohra, ban ioh pynlong ia ka ktem Mishon. U Syiem hadien u la ai jaka ha Nonglba (Nongsawlia). (Shaphang ka kyrteng 'Nongsawlia' pule ia ka lymrong "Ka Jingwanpoi u Thomas Jones"). 1843 : La pynmih la ka kot U Nongi'alam tang khyndai lynnong shuwa. La aiti noh ia ka kam pyniaid skul ha ki kti u Wil- liam Lewis. Ha ri Wales, la jer kyrteng thymmai ia ka Foreign Missionary Society da ka Welsh Calvinistic Meth- odists Foreign Missionary Society. 1844 ; U T. Jones u la duh noh ia u Dr. Owen Richards, haba la dkhat j3mdat ia ka kam missionary jong u ha Sohra, bad la hukum ban leit phai noh sha Bilad. La jia ha u biud March. U Thomas Jonas Bad Ka Pyrthei Saitsohpan 5 ~ 1845 : U August 12 tarilc. Ka lok u T. Jones ka la kha ia u khun shynrang. 22 Tarik u August. Ka mem Jones ka la khlad noh na ka pyrthei'. Ha kane ka snem u la pynmih Ya ka kot lyngkdop: Kijingnoai Niam ban iarjmi Im skul bad ha kijingiaseng mane blei. Khambun ki dei ki jingrwai jong u, khyndiat tylli jong u William Lewis. Hadien ka jingiap ka lok, u la leit sha Kolkata ban phah sumar la lade. U da rah lang ar tylli ki dulir jingthoh : (i) Ka Gospel u Mathi (ii) jong U Nongialam. 1 846 : Mar sdang snem, u la wan phai biang sha Sohra, ryngkat

arngut ki missionary thymmai: u Daniel Jones bad ka lok jong u. Ki poi sohra : 23 February. Ha u September 16 tarik. U la lathoh shongkurim bad ka Emma Jane Cartel, ka khun jong u George Cartel bad ka Susan Elizabeth Halford. La pyniathoh da u Chaplain jong ka Sylhet. November 5 tarik. U la mih na Sohra, ban leit Yalap biang sha ki thaifi Jaintia Hills, ban wad jaka trei de na ka bynta u Daniel Jones. Ki la Yapoi haduh Jowai. November 13 tarik. Ki la wanphai noh bad poi ha Sohra. Sngi Balang, 2 tarik u December. U T. Jones u la 1 . Ym dei ha ka '22 April 1 846' kumba la thoh ha ka kot ">4 brief life sketch on the life and works of Reverend Thomas Jones r pp. 25, 52. Cf. M.G Lyngdoh : Recapture, p. 11. 6 U Thomas Jones Bad Ka Pyrthei Saitsohpen duh noh la u para nongtrei baieid, ha kane ka sngi u Daniel Jones u la Yap noh na ka jingpang ma- laria, tang 9 bnai ha Sohra. Sngi Thohdieng, 4 larik u December. U la duh noh sa la u lok baieit eh jong u, u Kapten William Lewin uba la Yoh kajuh ka jingpang khieshoh khlaw. U Lewin u dang 40 snem. Ma kane ka snem, la shon bad pynmih biang Ya ka kot First Khasi Primer. 1847 : Ha u bnai February. Shi hajar kopi ki Gospel u Mnthi, ba la phah shon da u T. Jones ha Kolkata, ki la poi sha ri Khasi. Ka jingkmen bah Ya ki bricw kein! Ha u March 6 tarik. U T. Jones u la sdang ban pynYeng Ya ka Ying jong u ha thaifi Mylliem, hapoh hima Mylliem. Ha u bnai April. U la mih noh na Nongsawlia (Sohra) bad leit sah noh ha Mylliem. Kumta, u la dkhat noh ka jingYadei bad ka Mishon ha Sohra. Ha u October 8 tarik. Ka Mishon na Bilad ka la pynkut pynwai noh syndon Ya ka jingYadei jong ka bad u Thomas Jones. U Hajar Sing, syiem

Mylliem, u la ujor pyrshah Ya u T. Jones ba ka jingsah jong u ha Mylliem ka long beain. U T. Jones u ngeit ba dei u Harry Inglis, na Saitsohpen, uba la kynshoit, pynshoi bad pynshit Ya u Hajar Sing. La Yalam sha ka mokotduma ha Kashari Saitsohpen. 1848 : U T. Jones u la poi ha Pomreng, hajan ka shnong Mawber mynta. Ym dei ha Puriang ne Pomura U Thomas Jones Bad Ka Pyrthai Saitsohpen 7 ~ kumba la mut mano re. Shipor u la shong la sah ha ka Bangla u Stainforth; hadien pat u la thaw la ka jong ka iing. Ha u bnai December, la wan poi u Dunbar ha Sohra, ban pynlong ka jingtohkit ia ki kam ki jingleh jong u Harry Inglis. Dei sha u Dunbar ba u T. Jones u la thoh la ka shithi kaba i'athuh ia ki kam bymhok jong ka kashari Saitsohpen, ia ka jinghangamei jong u Inglis bad jingthombor ia ki paidbah. 1849 : Ha u bnai August. U Inglis u la phah da ki riewbymman, ha ki riam puht, ban thwetia u Tho- mas Jones, ki da thmu ban shim syndon ia ka jingim jong u. U la lait da ka said bad phet iap sha Gauhati. Hangne, la ai jingiada da u Jenkins, u Commis- sioner ka Assam. September 4 tarik. U la poi bad hiar lieng ha Kolkata, hapdeng ka jingtlot bakhraw. U la ioh jingisnei ha ka iing u Rev. David Ewart jong ka Free Church na ri Scotland. 16 tarik u September. U la iap noh ha iing u Ewart. 17 tarik u September. La tep ia u Thomas Jones ha Kolkata. t=X=t loyngkot l)hQphang U Jacob Tomlin Lah ban ong, da ka jingsngew skhem, ba ka jingwan poi jong u Thomas Jones sha ri Khasi ka long da ka jingkyntu u Mynsiem hapoh jong u bad da ka bor jingithuhpaw ba kynja mynsiem. Ym lah len ruh ia ka jingshisha ba ka iasnoh ter ter bad ki ar ngut ki riewblei, kita ki long u Rev. Jacob Tomlin bad u Kapten William

Lewin. U Jacob Tomlin u dei uwei na ki mishoneri jong ka London Missionary Society. Ym shym la hiew ia u kum u mishoneri, hynrei tang kum u agent jong ka Society. (Ref. KAS Souvenir, p.3). Katto katne snem u la trei ha Malaka, ka bynta (jylla) shathie lam mihngi ka ri Ma- laysia. Ha ka snem 1836, u la iakhlad lok noh na ka Lon- don Missionary Society. Katba u dang don ha Malaka, u la iatrei ryngkat bad u Rev. Josiah Hughes^ uba long u mishoneri hangto. U Tomlin u bat ia ka kyrdan kum u agent. U J.H. Morris u la thoh: For some years Mr. Tomlin had worked in Mal- acca as agent of the London Missionary Society, 1 . U Josiah Hughes u dei uba na Liveipool U Thomas Jonas Bad Ka Pyrthaf Saitsohptn 9 ~ and had thus been a fellow-labourer of Mr. Josiah Hughes^ U Tomlin u la iehnoh ia ka lyngkha trei ha ka snem 1836 bad u la wan poi ha Kolkata. Don eiei kaba pher ha ka jingiadei kine ki mishoneri bad ka London Mission- ary Society, namar ngi iohi ba u Josiah Hughes ruh u la dkhat noh ia lade na ka Society ha kajuh ka snem^. Nalor kata, ka paw ba u Tomlin um da kwah ban shah teh shah khum ha ka London Missionary Society, bad namar ba u dei u riewdon riewem, u kham jied ban long u mishoneri uba Iciitluid, khlem da pan jingkyrshan peisa tyngka nano nano. La don ka jinglhmu bad jingmut jong u ban leit ialap ia ka kospel sha ka ri Shin (China), da kaba i'aid lyngba ka ri Khasi bad Assam. Hynrei la pyndam noh ia ka jingangnud bakhraw jong u, haba ka higa bad 3 ngut ki khun kynthei jong u ki la kem pang noh ha Kolkata. La sumar la ki, tangba ki doktor ki la ai jingmut ba dei ban leit phai noh shuwa sha Bilad, ban ioh shong pyngngad ha la ri shipor arpor. Kane ka la jia shuwa ban kut ka snem 1836. Kumta, u

saheb Tomlin bad ka ring jong u ki la rai ban mih na Kolkata mar iasdang u bnai January 1837. 2. The History of the Welsh Calvimstic Methodists 'Foreign Mission: P. 34. 3. Josiah Hu^es ‘sailed for Malacca April 27'^ where he arrived November 21 ^ (1830). His connection with the Society was dissolved in 1836. He then proceeded to Calcutta, and was granted Church orders by Dr. Wilson, Bishop of Calcutta, returning to Malacca as Chaplain. He died on the 25th November, 1840, ftom an attack of cholera’. (Morris: THWCMFM^ p. 300). Note: Homeward bound aboard the S.S. Gregson, after more than ten years service in the far east, was the English missionaiy Jacob Tomlin, with his wile and three little girls. Woridng at first under the auspices of the London Missionary Society and then on his own account, Tomlin had travelled widely, visiting Singapore, Java, Siam and Malacca where he had been a fellowlabourer of the Welsh missionary Josiah Hughes. He left Malacca for Calcutta in 1836, intending to take his family with him to the Khasi Hills, and cross fiom there into China. 10 U Thoiran Jones Bad Ka Pyrthei Saitsohpen Pynban ai'u la jia la ki? Haba la biang lut ka jingpynkhreh nadong shadong, ha ka 10 tarik u Janu- ary la poi ka por bad ka sngi ban kiew lieng ha kad jhad Kolkata. Khyndiat sngi haba ka jhad S.S. Gregson ka la rung i'a ka duriaw (Bay of Bengal), ka la pluh hapdeng duriaw ha ka 17 tarik, por 11 baje mynmiet bad la ong ba ki tiar ki tar, ki mar ki mata jong ki baroh ki la ing lut, hynrei phylla toi ba ki briew ki lait im. La iathuh ba u saheb mishoneri bad ka i'ing jong u baroh ki la lait im da ka said. Ki la hap ban wan phai dien biang sha Kolkata. Kawei pat ka jhad kaba dei ban leit sha London ka la wan iarap bad pyllait ia baroh, bad leit buh biang ia ki sha Kolkata.. Dei ha kum kane ka khen ba u saheb

Tomlin u la kut jingmut biang, sa shisien sa shiwat, ban pynurlong ia ka jingangnud ba myashuwa, ba la kumno kumno ruh, dei ban leit jngoh i'a ka ri Khasi. Halor kane ka jingjia u J.H. Morris u batai kumne; How came the Calvinistic Methodists to adopt the Khasi Hills as their Mission Field? The man who brought the Hills to the notice of the Society's founders was the Rev. Jacob Tomlin, B.A, who for some years, had been a missionary in Malacca. When returning to this country, the ship in which he sailed took fire in the Bay of Bengal. Tomlin and his family were landed in Calcutta. Having a desire to visit China, Mr. Tomlin resolved to pro- ceed there overland. On his journey he came to the Khasi Hills, at that time a part of India almost entirely unknown. He spent nine months on the Note: Jan hamar kaba shiteng synflia, haba u nongfliah kajhad u la mih nob, la mih kyndit kyndit ka jingpyrta bad jingicyang kaba ong *Ka ding, ka ding, kajhad ka la pluh!’ [Ref: KAS Souvenir ISO: p.3. ’Thomas Jones and Wales” by Nigel Jenkins]. U Thomas Jonas Bad Ka Pyrthal Saitsohpen 11 ~ Hills. Owing to illness in his family, he returned to England, and resided in Treborth, near Bangor, North Wales. Here he came in touch with a num- ber of ministers of the Connexion upon whom he urged the adoption of the Khasi and Jaihtia Hills as the field of the newly-established Mission^. Puson kein. Lada ka jhad kam shym la pluh, ha to u Tomlin un jin da la wan poi sha ri Khasi? Em, ha ban da leilei ruh em. Lada kumta, mano te ban Tasaid na ka bynta ka ri Khasi? Mano ba tip ibh lehse, u Thomas Jones un jin da la poi sha ki thaih Gujerat, kumba la ai jingmut da u Dr. Wilson, Bombay.
